name: x-chrome-ui-changer
description: Responsive wide layout for X (formerly Twitter) desktop.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.content.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.popup.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:ts && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --check dist/content.js && node --check dist/popup.js && node --test .test-dist/*.test.js
